# Chen (2012) — Gel Manicure and Nail Thinning

A clinical note associating repeated gel manicures and acetone soak-off with
measurable **nail** plate thinning, cited by [[Gel Manicure Systems]].

## Finding

Repeated removal cycles — not the cured coating itself — drive most of the
observed thinning, suggesting technique matters more than the gel chemistry.

`(Source: Chen 2012 — high confidence)`
